import openpyxl
from openpyxl.worksheet.formula import ArrayFormula

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/45581/1_45581_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/45581_0_fa21ca44/1_45581_output.xlsx"

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path, data_only=False)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Find an existing formula that uses COUNTA over the character-splitting range,
# then modify it so blank formula results are not counted. COUNTA counts formulas
# returning "", causing vacant positions; COUNTIF(range,"?*") counts visible text.
source_formula = None
for row in ws.iter_rows():
    for cell in row:
        val = cell.value
        if isinstance(val, ArrayFormula):
            text = val.text
        elif isinstance(val, str) and cell.data_type == "f":
            text = val[1:] if val.startswith("=") else val
        else:
            continue
        if "COUNTA(" in text.upper():
            source_formula = text
            break
    if source_formula:
        break

if source_formula is None:
    raise ValueError("Could not find a formula containing COUNTA to modify.")

# Replace COUNTA(<range>) with COUNTIF(<same range>,"?*"), preserving the rest of the formula.
modified_formula = re.sub(
    r"COUNTA\(([^()]*)\)",
    r'COUNTIF(\1,"?*")',
    source_formula,
    flags=re.IGNORECASE
)

ws["D11"] = "=" + modified_formula.lstrip("=")

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification
check_wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)
check_ws = check_wb["Sheet1"]
print("D11:", check_ws["D11"].value, "data_type:", check_ws["D11"].data_type)
assert check_ws["D11"].value is not None
